mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_room (room_id, room_name, room_desc, owner_id, room_type, ext_config) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{roomName}, #{roomDesc}, #{ownerId}, #{roomType}, #{extConfig})
mapper.select: SELECT id, room_id, room_name, room_type, ext_config, status FROM ai_chat_room WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT room_id, room_name, room_type, status, create_time FROM ai_chat_room WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT r.room_id, r.room_name, r.room_type, r.status, r.create_time FROM ai_chat_room r INNER JOIN ai_chat_room_member m ON r.room_id = m.room_id WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND m.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
SELECT ext_config FROM ai_chat_room WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND is_deleted = 0

room_name = #{roomName}, room_desc = #{roomDesc}, ext_config = #{extConfig}, status = #{status},
